records.premise:
/iaso:iaso intent I want to improve the way we can track with iaso each debug and intent loop. from any iaso session related to a given project, I want to be able to track each intent loop and their progress, remaining actions, and also show a description of what is supposed to be achieved. Same for the debug loop and the evaluate loop

Question: This project already holds 10 intent loops on disk, 7 of them opened in October by sessions that are gone (some finished elsewhere, some abandoned). What should the list show for a loop nobody is working on any more?
Options: Show as idle, apart (Recommended) (Loops with a live session come first; loops with no session are kept below, marked 'idle since <date>', so nothing is lost and a new session can still take one over. Nothing is deleted by the list.); Only loops being worked on (The list holds only loops with a live session. Abandoned loops vanish from view (they stay on disk), so the list is short but a forgotten loop is never seen again.); Idle ones, with a way to close (As the first option, and the pane also lets you close an idle loop for good from the list. This makes the list act, not only show.)
Answer: Show as idle, apart (Recommended)
